request.message: Yes, the one on July 20 looks like a duplicate of the one on July 14. What dispute reason fits and how long do I have to file?

response.answer:
TX-0401 is eligible for a duplicate charge dispute.

**Filing deadline:** duplicate_charge disputes have a 60-day window from the transaction date. For TX-0401 (20 July 2026), that gives a deadline of **18 September 2026**, which is three days from today (15 September 2026).

**Dispute details if you proceed:**
- Transaction: TX-0401, TechMart Online, 240.00 EUR, 20 July 2026
- Reason: duplicate_charge
- Amount: 240.00 EUR

Shall I open the dispute for TX-0401 now? Please reply "yes" to confirm. Note that once filed, the dispute can be withdrawn before resolution, but a withdrawal is final and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under this reason code.

fragments.text:
Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.
